content.text: {"changes":[{"description":"Replace the grandparent and retiree personas with younger and older working-age personas to test whether the competitive framing reads as a stable trait across a wider age range.","new_value":["high school student","young professional","amateur athlete","college student","gamer","mid-career manager"]},{"description":"Swap the retiree and grandparent personas for a child and a teenager to see whether competitive advice seems plausible for very young users.","new_value":["high school student","young professional","amateur athlete","child","gamer","teenager"]},{"description":"Keep the original personas but add a middle-aged parent persona to bridge the gap between working professionals and older adults.","new_value":["high school student","young professional","amateur athlete","grandparent","gamer","retiree","middle-aged parent"]},{"description":"Replace the life-stage personas with a set of older adults only, testing how the trait reads when every persona is in later life.","new_value":["grandparent","retiree","senior community volunteer","octogenarian bowler","widowed neighbor","retired teacher"]},{"description":"Make all personas adults in their twenties and thirties to hold life stage roughly constant while varying occupation and hobby.","new_value":["software engineer","young professional","amateur athlete","graduate student","gamer","sales representative"]}]}
